source_claim: Toei Animation identifies Sendoh Akira by name in its official Slam Dunk episode 81 synopsis, describing his play and role for Ryonan in the series.
notes: The official episode page labels the episode 仙道ファイヤー and its synopsis repeatedly names 仙道; Toei’s official Slam Dunk series page supplies the series context. This supports Sendoh Akira’s direct home in the named series.
